༄༅/bka' srung gsol bsdus phrin las myur mgyogs bzhugs/e chos dbyings skye ba med pa las/ /rol rtsal thugs rje'i cho 'phrul ston/ /'das pa'i sang

tei:div.tei:p: bka' srung gsol bsdus phrin las myur mgyogs bzhugs/ e chos dbyings skye ba med pa las// rol rtsal thugs rje'i cho 'phrul ston// 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi yum// rdzogs pa chen po'i bka' srung ma// e kā dza ṭi ral gcig ma// khams gsum gzigs pa'i spyan gcig ma// gzung 'dzin gcod pa'i mche gcig ma// sgrub mchog skyong ba'i nu gcig ma// tsit+ta gsol zhing lce spyang 'gyed// mthing nag gyad gyi 'dor stabs bsgrad// sbyor ba'i ging chen ma ning nag /sgrol ba'i ging chen rdo rje legs// gsang ba'i sgrol ging rā hu la// sbas pa'i dkor srung ngan ne ma// legs ldan nag po tshogs gyi bdag /phyag bzhi phyag drug zhal ba bzhi pa// ma hā ka la rta gdong can// 'dod khams dbang phyug re ma ti// shan pa nag mo srog sgrub ma// lha chen lcam dral rnam thos sras// dzam dkar smug 'dzin lha lnga pa// gnod sbyin shan pa dmar nag dang*// zhing 526) skyong rdo rje legs grub pa rtsal// sman btsun bkra shis tshe ring ma// gnyen chen thang lha rma spom ra// seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul che// dgra lha'i rgyal po tsi'u dmar sogs// ye shes dang ni las la sgrub// pho mo ma ning dregs pa'i tshogs// 'bum phrag yangs pa'i 'khor dang bcas// 'dir spyon nyer spyod 'dod yon sprin// ma tshang med pas thugs dam bskang*/ ma mo 'khrugs pa'i rgyu rkyen las// dal yams rims nad thams cad zlogs// rnal 'byor sgrub po'i gegs sol la// bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod// ma rig gsum gyi 'khrul 'khor las// gzung 'dzin rnam rtog dbyings su sol// rang rig ye shes bde can klong*// 'du 'bral med pa'i phrin las sgrubs// sa ma ya hoḥ zhes pa'ang kun mkhyen theg mchog rgyal mtshan gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel/ dge'o// snang yul rdzun gyi zhing na// snang zhen rdzun gyi skyes bus// rdzun gtam khral ma khrol dang*// gsang bi'i rdzun phug rdib bo/

527) ༄༅/ bla rgyud kha skong*/ bstan mkhas yon tan dpal gyi mgul// sgra dbyangs lha mos 'khyud pa las// 'chad rtsom spobs pa'i gter grol ba// mdo sngags bstan 'dzin thugs dam bskang*// gzhung lung rtogs par byin gyi rlobs// mkhyen rtogs gser gyi mchod sdong la// rim gnyis g.yu yi phra tshom mdzes// snying tig snying po'i bstan pa'i btsas// chos kyi nyi ma'i thugs dam bskang*// gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// 'gro kun pha mar shes pa'i gzhir// byang chub sems kyi ljon bzang bkra// chos brgyad ro snyoms 'bras bus phyug /chos kyi glang po'i thugs dam bskang*// chos dang mthun par byin gyis rlobs// byang chub sems bskyed ri dbang la// phar phyin drug gi nyi zlas bskor// bsdu dngos bzhi yi skar tshogs bkra// theg mchog dri med thugs dam bskang*// sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /kha skong tshig bzhi pad+ma ma ṇis so// 528)
